Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/plain', uri: 'https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt'), { 'chunking' => { 'chunker_type' => 'text', 'max_characters' => 300, 'overlap' => 40, 'trim' => true } })
puts result.results[0].chunks.inspect
```
